Construct a source-linked, gap-aware publication figure specification

Source: R/publication-visualization-v2.R
aqt_viz2_spec.Rd

Use either validated aqt_tracks with a *declared finite gap_limit_s*, or an existing QC 2.0 report with an explicit policy_id when multiple policies were audited. Trajectory positions remain visible as original samples, while line segments and speed points derive solely from eligible consecutive QC movement steps; neither missing nor excluded steps connect. For 3D data, xz and yz are explicitly 2D projections, not 3D scenes. Position coordinates must be comparable within one session/camera scope.

Usage

aqt_viz2_spec(
  data,
  figure = c("paths", "speed", "qc_coverage", "qc_reasons"),
  gap_limit_s = NULL,
  policy_id = NULL,
  session_id = NULL,
  camera_id = NULL,
  plane = c("xy", "xz", "yz"),
  preset = "journal_double",
  caption = "",
  source_file = NULL
)

Arguments

data

aqt_tracks or an unmodified aqt_qc2_report.

figure

paths, speed, qc_coverage or qc_reasons.

gap_limit_s

Finite positive maximum intersample time (seconds), required for raw aqt_tracks; an existing QC 2.0 report owns its policies.

policy_id

Exact QC policy ID; required if report has >1 policy.

session_id, camera_id

Optional scope selectors, mandatory for multi-session or multi-camera input.

plane

xy, xz or yz. Non-xy planes require actual 3D tank input.

preset

Generic figure size/dpi preset from aqt_viz2_presets().

caption

Researcher-supplied descriptive caption.

source_file

Optional immutable existing source CSV/data file; SHA-256 recorded and checked at export, and must match a QC2 CSV source digest.

Value

Sealed aqt_viz2_spec with original row IDs, eligible segments, all QC decisions, plot source hashes, units, and figure metadata.
